mijovia-no-categories: Message to show when no categories available
mijovia-skip: Keyboard link that skips the navigation and moves to the page heading.
mijovia-top-navigation: Accessible name of the top navigation landmark.
mijovia-pages: Label under the number of articles in the community header.
mijovia-discuss: Accessible name of the community discussion control.
mijovia-theme-light: Accessible label for switching to the light theme.
mijovia-theme-dark: Accessible label for switching to the dark theme.
mijovia-width: Accessible name of the article width toggle.
mijovia-save: Label of the control to save an article.
mijovia-page-tools: Accessible name of the page actions menu button.
mijovia-sign-in: Label of the account sign-in link in the top bar.
mijovia-create-account: Label of the registration link in the top bar.
mijovia-home: Label of the main page link in the global navigation rail.
mijovia-explore: Label of the all-pages link in the global navigation rail.
mijovia-saved: Label of the saved pages control in the global navigation rail.
mijovia-progress: Label of the reading progress control in the global navigation rail.
mijovia-history: Label of the page revision history link in the global navigation rail.
mijovia-utilities: Label of the special pages link in the global navigation rail.
mijovia-network: Label of the Fandom network control in the global navigation rail.
mijovia-settings: Label of the preferences link and the lower global navigation landmark.
mijovia-more: Label of the additional options control in the global navigation rail.
mijovia-in-categories: Label for a page’s category count. $1 is the number of categories.
mijovia-user-menu: Label for the Account menu control in the signed-in layout.
mijovia-recent-activity: Label for the Recent Wiki Activity control in the signed-in layout.
mijovia-my-tools: Label for the My Tools control in the signed-in layout.
mijovia-customize: Label for the Customize control in the signed-in layout.
mijovia-shortcuts: Label for the Shortcuts control in the signed-in layout.
mijovia-notifications: Label for the signed-in notifications button.
mijovia-notifications-mark-read: Button to mark alerts and notices as read.
mijovia-notifications-loading: Status while loading the notifications panel.
mijovia-notifications-empty: Status when there are no unread notifications.
mijovia-notifications-error: Status when a notification request fails.
mijovia-notifications-retry: Button to retry loading the notifications panel.
mijovia-notifications-all: Link to the full notifications history.
mijovia-ranks: Label for the ranks slot in the signed-in navigation rail.
mijovia-new: Badge marking a new feature in the navigation rail.
mijovia-rail-hide: Label for the button that collapses the article's right sidebar.
mijovia-rail-show: Label for the button that restores all widgets in the article's right sidebar.
mijovia-toolbar-show: Label for the button that restores the signed-in toolbar.
mijovia-toolbar-title: Toolbar customization dialog text: “Customize Your Toolbar”.
mijovia-toolbar-add-title: Toolbar customization dialog text: “Add A Tool”.
mijovia-toolbar-search: Toolbar customization dialog text: “Search for tool”.
mijovia-toolbar-advanced: Toolbar customization dialog text: “list of advanced contributor tools”.
mijovia-toolbar-move-menu: Toolbar customization dialog text: “Move into My Tools”.
mijovia-toolbar-move-bar: Toolbar customization dialog text: “Move onto toolbar”.
mijovia-toolbar-empty: Toolbar customization dialog text: “No available tools.”.
mijovia-toolbar-error: Toolbar customization dialog text: “The toolbar could not be saved. Try again.”.
mijoviathemedesigner: Name of the Mijovia skin theme designer special page and its account menu link.
right-mijoviathemedesigner: Description of the permission to use the Mijovia skin Theme Designer.
action-mijoviathemedesigner: Phrase used in permission errors for the Mijovia skin Theme Designer.
mijovia-theme-help: Instructions above the theme editor fields.
mijovia-theme-default: Placeholder for a field that uses the default theme value.
mijovia-theme-logo: Label for the shared wiki logo field.
mijovia-theme-no-logo: Checkbox that hides the wiki logo.
mijovia-theme-no-banner: Checkbox that hides the banner image in the selected color mode.
mijovia-theme-light: Label for the light theme palette and preview mode.
mijovia-theme-dark: Label for the dark theme palette and preview mode.
mijovia-theme-banner: Label for the banner image field.
mijovia-theme-site: Label for the color behind the article and tools panels.
mijovia-theme-header: Label for the fixed navigation header color.
mijovia-theme-article: Label for the article panel background color.
mijovia-theme-rail: Label for the right panel background color.
mijovia-theme-text: Label for the article text color.
mijovia-theme-link: Label for the wiki link color.
mijovia-theme-accent: Label for the accent color used on controls.
mijovia-theme-draft: Button to save a personal theme draft.
mijovia-theme-publish: Button to publish the theme for the wiki.
mijovia-theme-reset: Button to save a personal draft using the bundled theme defaults.
mijovia-theme-restore: Button to publish the previous theme as a new revision.
mijovia-theme-history: Link to the history of published theme revisions.
mijovia-theme-rebase: Button to permit publishing a retained draft over an explicitly reviewed newer theme.
mijovia-theme-draft-saved: Confirmation after saving or resetting a personal draft.
mijovia-theme-restored: Confirmation after restoring a previous theme.
mijovia-theme-stale: Warning when another administrator has edited the theme.
mijovia-theme-error-color: Validation error for an invalid or unsupported hex color.
mijovia-theme-error-image: Validation error for a missing or unsupported image.
mijovia-theme-error-permission: Error when the administrator cannot edit the theme configuration page.
mijovia-theme-error-save: Error after MediaWiki rejects a theme publication.
mijovia-theme-error-restore: Error when there is no previous theme to restore.
mijovia-theme-publish-summary: Revision summary for publishing a theme.
mijovia-theme-restore-summary: Revision summary for restoring the previous theme.
mijovia-theme-preview: Heading and accessible label for the preview frame.
mijovia-theme-preview-mode: Label for the preview mode selector.
mijovia-theme-preview-page: Label for the preview page selector.
mijovia-theme-home: Option to preview the configured home page.
mijovia-theme-preview-article: Option to preview an existing article.
mijovia-theme-article-title: Label for the title of the wiki page to preview.
mijovia-theme-preview-choose-article: Preview status when the selected title cannot be loaded.
mijovia-theme-preview-loading: Preview status while the selected wiki page loads.
mijovia-theme-preview-unavailable: Preview status when the wiki page or settings cannot be loaded.
mijovia-theme-contrast-article: Warning beside a text or link color that has insufficient contrast on the article surface.
mijovia-theme-contrast-rail: Warning beside a text or link color that has insufficient contrast on the right panel.
